<b>Roachkeepers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are bulky, hooded [[Roach Tenders]] wearing spiked headgear and wielding large chains.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Roachkeepers walk back and forth, occasionally stopping before resuming their walking.
A Roachkeeper has three attacks that can be chosen at random:
* <b>Chain Punch:</b> They wrap their chain around their fist for half a second and lunge forward with a punch. The hitbox on their fist remains until they fully end the attack, giving it a deceptively lingering hitbox.
* <b>Chain Whip:</b> They swing their chain around themselves wildly in a semi-circle, covering both sides. Combos Hornet, dealing {{Damage|1+1}} if she is caught in it at any time.
* <b>Jump:</b> They can jump in a forward or backward arc, and are entirely invincible during the jump.

Roachkeepers deal {{Damage|2}} on all attacks and upon contact. They wear spikes on their back and head that protect them from attacks from above. 

Staying on the ground makes it easier to evade a Roachkeeper's jump attacks. They are most vulnerable to Needle attacks after throwing a punch. Hornet can jump or needle-bounce over them and attack from behind, or stand just outside of their lunging distance to attack them from the front.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Roachkeepers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Herd them...
* Bind them...
* Feed the many...
* None shall starve...
}}

== Location ==
Roachcatchers can be found in the northern sections of [[Sinner's Road]]. The Roachkeeper at the east end of the top hallway can be permanently killed by [[Garmond and Zaza]].

The Roachkeeper in the northeast drops a [[Simple Key (Silksong)|Simple Key]] when killed.
